paragraphs: Unite Us sells software and data infrastructure for coordinating whole-person care across healthcare, government and community-based organizations. Its named audiences include public health and human services agencies. Managed care and Medicaid plans are also on that list.

The core product is a closed-loop referral system for sending and receiving electronic social care referrals within a network of community partners. Staff can run social needs screenings, after which the platform automatically suggests resources or referrals. A secure chat feature lets users at partner organizations message each other about shared referrals, cases and clients. Integrations let organizations share resources and send referrals without leaving their own system.

Alongside referrals, the company sells predictive analytics meant to predict long-term risks and measure impact. Its Population Insights tool combines social, economic, environmental and health information with modeling to identify at-risk populations. It also automates payments to community-based organizations. The company states that it partnered with Presbyterian Health Plan to create New Mexico's first statewide closed-loop referral system.
